Sam (FinOps): Heads up — spotted an invoice discrepancy for BrightPath (INV-2025-0421). After their reserved-tier cutover there was a tail-end usage surge that appears to have double-counted ingestion for ~2h. Can we approve a goodwill credit?

Kevin (Sales): Oof, that's the migration we supported last week. Do we know magnitude and whether this is committed vs burst billing?

Anya (Customer Support): They opened ticket #3421. Support dug into logs — looks like duplicate webhook retries triggered replayed events during the cutover window. Recommending a manual credit for the overage.

Anya (Customer Support): Relevant snippet from the ingestion log:```
2025-03-31T22:05:12Z POST /events 200 id=abc123
2025-03-31T22:05:12Z POST /events 200 id=abc123 (replayed)
2025-03-31T23:17:03Z POST /events 200 id=def456
```

Marta (Finance): Need amount, GL code, and confirmation this is one-time (not impacting MRR). Also annotate whether tax needs recalculation.

Sam (FinOps): Date range: 2025-03-31 22:00 -> 2025-04-01 01:00. Net overage = $1,120 (pre-tax). GL: 4-2300 (Customer Credits). This is one-time goodwill; doesn't change subscription MRR. No extra tax reclaim necessary — tidy as credit on the invoice. @Marta please sign off for accounting.

Kevin (Sales): Sales is OK to cover this as goodwill to keep relationship healthy. :thumbsup: @Marta any concerns?

Marta (Finance): Approved. Please include memo "goodwill_credit: BrightPath - duplicate ingestion during migration" and supply source ticket #3421 for audit.

billing-bot: ACTION: Creating credit record...
billing-bot: CREDIT_CREATED CR-2025-0047 applied to INV-2025-0421 amount $1,120. Accounting ticket ACCT-7890 opened. Posting ETA: immediate on invoice, GL posting on next AR batch.

Anya (Customer Support): Updated ticket #3421 and messaged the customer: "We've applied a $1,120 goodwill credit to your invoice INV-2025-0421 while we continue to investigate. Thanks for flagging this."

Sam (FinOps): Thanks — I'll add this to month-end reconciliation queue and include the incident summary for model/cutover playbook updates. @Marta can you confirm when ACCT-7890 is closed so I can mark reconciled?

Marta (Finance): Will confirm once AR batch posts and ACCT-7890 is closed.

Kevin (Sales): Thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
